purpose: Make retained-scope, receipt/current-state lineage, decision supersession, incident repair references, continuity obligations, acceptance boundaries and future public/equivalence handoff requirements fail visibly when they contradict or silently orphan work.

lineage.outcome: Accepted or unfinished work cannot silently disappear across the existing repository governance ledgers, and future equivalence/public-handoff claims must carry explicit durable proof without turning the checker into a second authority.

why_now: PR #249 merged the first-class incident-repair lifecycle as 2283d08f05e4445762333f607e2af4416e375696, preserving parent incident #206 as OPEN. The next bounded repair closes the remaining internal repository cross-ledger integrity gap without selecting product work or inventing a second authority.

implementation_contract.reuse: Read and reconcile existing requirements, completion graph, current_state, active_receipt, incidents, decisions, acceptance evidence, action-receipt, work-continuity, discovery-closure and continuity-acceptance authorities. Do not create a second candidate queue, scope ledger, current-state owner or Steward.
implementation_contract.retention: held_or_boundary must remain exactly represented by LATER-01; graph requirements must remain inside canonical scope; continuity/discovery contracts must preserve unfinished work and explicit dispositions.
implementation_contract.lineage: ACTIVE current_state and receipt must agree on node/increment and exact baseline; incident repair IDs must resolve to current open incident truth with receipt-bound repair authority.
implementation_contract.supersession: New supersession requires exact candidate equivalence evidence. If the explicitly supplied exact predecessor cannot be inspected, validation fails closed rather than skipping the comparison. Historical supersession without local proof is not silently upgraded into an equivalence claim.
implementation_contract.public_boundary: A receipt declaring a public handoff requirement must carry a durable handoff reference, and repository integration may not fabricate PUBLIC_VERIFIED.
implementation_contract.trust: After bootstrap, the trusted base Steward workflow executes the base copy of check_steward_integrity.py. Future changes to the checker or its contract require the same explicit steward-meta-governance-reopen signal used for privileged Steward workflow changes.

completion_proof: completion graph references outside canonical scope fail
superseded semantic decisions without durable successors fail
resolved or unknown incident repair authority fails
declared public handoff without durable handoff reference fails
SUPERSEDED_BY_EQUIVALENT without complete semantic evidence fails
newly added superseded requirements require exact candidate equivalence evidence
explicit predecessor lookup failure fails closed
acceptance-evidence states remain distinct through consumer acceptance and value evidence
work continuity and discovery closure retain unfinished work/dispositions
future PRs run the integrity checker from the trusted base copy
future checker/contract mutations require explicit Main Steward meta-governance reopen
full existing governance/product test suite and exact-head platform matrix remain required before integration
non_scope: public deployment execution or public acceptance authority
dependencies: PR #249 merged as exact live-main predecessor 2283d08f05e4445762333f607e2af4416e375696. Its post-merge trusted structure is green; its full three-platform post-merge governance run must remain green before this successor receives a main slot.
next_selection_rule: Qualify this bounded #206 repair only on exact main predecessor 2283d08f05e4445762333f607e2af4416e375696 after #249 post-merge verification. Any new main movement invalidates prior integration proof and requires explicit revalidation or rebuild rather than silent retargeting.
